notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
🏎️ New Race Car: A brand-new exotic, AWD supercar. Lambo vibes with sharp handling and raw speed. Try it out!

🚨 Police Chase Improvements: Police chases are now less punishing! If the police slow you down, they lose momentum and power. Making it easier to escape.

🧠 Smarter AI Racers: Opponents now handle corners more intelligently for a more competitive race experience.

🛫 Ramp Shortcuts: Ramps now launch you along predefined paths, turning them into real shortcuts you can use to your advantage.

🔥 Ready to test your skills and see where you rank on the leaderboards? Download the updated demo now and dive into the chaos!

👉 Try the Updated Demo Here

notes.title: Three New Races Added
notes.content:
What to expect:
🏁 Challenging new tracks on the second island

🔄 Some sections include backtracking parts, which may cause intense head on collisions
